en.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Sees Massive Player Surge Driven by Edgerunners Season 2
en.summary: Night City is buzzing again as Cyberpunk 2077 hits its biggest Steam player peak in years, fueled by the launch of its acclaimed anime sequel. This resurgence highlights the enduring power of transmedia storytelling in revitalizing even established game worlds.
en.body:
**Cyberpunk 2077** is once again drawing massive crowds to the neon-drenched streets of Night City, with its concurrent player count on Steam soaring to impressive new heights. The game recently peaked at over 187,000 players, a figure not seen since the release of the substantial **Phantom Liberty** expansion and Update 2.0 back in October 2023. This surge is a clear indicator that the game, originally launched in December 2020, continues to hold a powerful allure for players worldwide.

The primary catalyst for this renewed interest appears to be the recent launch of **Edgerunners Season 2**, the highly anticipated second season of the anime series that shares its universe with the game. Just as the first season of **Edgerunners** is credited with a significant revival of **Cyberpunk 2077**'s fortunes, the new season seems to be having a similar, if not greater, impact. This transmedia approach has proven incredibly effective, drawing in both existing fans eager to revisit Night City and newcomers captivated by the anime's gritty, punk-rock aesthetic and compelling narrative.

## Night City's Enduring Appeal

Beyond the anime's influence, CD Projekt Red has also been actively supporting **Cyberpunk 2077** with meaningful updates. The latest patch, coinciding with the anime's release, introduced a host of new features and improvements. Players can now experience dual-wielding, experiment with new cosmetic items, customize their cyberware fashion, and explore even more digital tourism opportunities within the sprawling metropolis. A new story mission directly linked to **Edgerunners** further bridges the gap between the game and the anime, offering a more integrated experience for fans.

Furthermore, CD Projekt Red has implemented a significant discount on the **Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition** on Steam, slashing the price by 70%. This aggressive pricing strategy makes the comprehensive package, including the base game and all expansions, incredibly accessible to a wider audience, undoubtedly contributing to the increased player traffic. It's a smart move that capitalizes on the current buzz and encourages new players to dive into the definitive **Cyberpunk 2077** experience.

## A Community Reinvigorated

The impact of **Edgerunners Season 2** is palpable within the **Cyberpunk 2077** community. Players are returning in droves, sharing their experiences and rediscovering the intricate details of Night City. The game's ability to maintain such a strong player base years after its initial release, especially for a single-player focused RPG, is a testament to its rich world-building and the ongoing efforts by the developers to refine and expand upon it. The synergy between the game and its anime adaptation has created a virtuous cycle, with each feeding into the popularity of the other.

## What's Next

With the success of **Edgerunners Season 2** and the continued support from CD Projekt Red, it's likely that **Cyberpunk 2077** will maintain this elevated level of engagement. Players can look forward to further refinements and potentially more content updates as the developers continue to nurture their ambitious project. The game's future looks brighter than ever, proving that a strong narrative and a dedicated community can overcome even the most challenging of launches.

content_raw: Almost six years after launch, Cyberpunk 2077 still has a healthy player base, especially with a new anime spin-off driving people to the Night City source material. The second season of Edgerunners launched last week alongside a beefy update for Cyberpunk 2077 , and unsurprisingly, PC player numbers have spiked. At the time of writing, Cyberpunk 2077 player numbers had surged to 187,215 players on PC via Steam alone. That's the biggest peak since October 2023, when the game received the substantial Update 2.0 and the Phantom Liberty expansion. This new tick in players is likely being experienced on other PC platforms where the game is available (like GOG and the Epic Games Store), as well as on multiple consoles like PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch 2. With a new update that adds dual-wielding, new cosmetics, customizable cyberware fashion, even more digital tourism, and a new story mission linked to Edgerunners, it's no wonder that player numbers are climbing again. You also can't discount Edgerunners' impact, as the Netflix anime series is likely driving an influx of new players. The first season of Edgerunners is credited with playing a major role in Cyberpunk 2077's revival after its infamous December 2020 launch , and Edgerunners Season 2 probably makes a good case for returning to the game. CD Projekt Red has also discounted Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition by 70% on Steam, so the entry price is pretty cheap right now. That increased foot traffic is even bigger this time: after Edgerunners Season 1 launched, Cyberpunk 2077 player numbers on Steam peaked at 136,724 in September 2022. If you want a peek behind the curtain, you can read up on Edgerunners Season 2 has a punk rock vibe , how it ties into the first season , and yes, that is a sneaky Hideo Kojima cameo in the show. Meanwhile, work on Cyberpunk 2 is continuing, and game director Gabe Amatangelo says the sequel is evolving beyond his vision for it.
